title: Robust Optimal Reinsurance, Investment,and Surplus Allocation for Epstein-Zin Preferences
summary: In this paper, we investigate the robust optimal reinsurance,investment,and internal surplus distribution (i.e., consumption) problem for an insurer with Epstein-Zin recursive preferences in an incomplete market. It is assumed that the insurer can allocate wealth to a financial market consisting of a risk-free asset and a risky asset, where the price process of the risky asset follows a diffusion process with a stochastic drift rate governed by an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (O-U) process.
